session_notes: Stim screen (i.e., crosshair display) was unresponsive when we first began the scan. Participant was given the instructions to keep their eyes open & to remain still, while allowing their thoughts to wonder, during the structure and perfusion scans. We were eventually able to load the crosshair, and were only without it for about 2-minutes of the first structure scan. The participant was very still and stated he kept his eyes open when the crosshair was not initially visible.
